_note: SEPARATE FILE ON PURPOSE. config/phase_10d_diag1.json and its hash 0879d61c are cited throughout results/phase_10d_diag1/REPORT.md; adding fields there would change that hash and stale the committed record. Nothing here is a measurement parameter -- the frames, the ladder and every number are Diag1's, unchanged.

upstream._tape_review_why: The 43 events that received a 10d tape-review chart. CH-R4 makes 8-min coverage of this set a hard stop.

coverage.event_set: union of the 43 tape-review events and Diag1's 7 pre-registered subset events
coverage._union_why: ACET 2020-09-18 and OST 2024-06-13 are in Diag1's subset but not the tape-review set, because 10c declines both at the 8-min kernel (insufficient_context) so neither received a tape chart. They are emitted anyway and appear at the 32-min kernel, where 10c does resolve them. No event is dropped and none is invented.
coverage.dark_theme_scope: Diag1's 7-event pre-registered subset only, per the addendum's coverage table

emission._emit_thin_why: The addendum is explicit: every frame, boundary or not. Roughly half of all kernel-width frames are thin (<30 in-window intervals) and the chart washes them grey. Suppressing them would flatter the picture by hiding how much of the session cannot support a shape.
emission._emit_density_for_thin_why: A thin frame still has a histogram -- it is just noisy. Emitting it lets the wash sit ON the drawn field rather than over a hole, which is what makes the caveat legible. has_boundary stays FALSE for those frames, so nothing downstream mistakes a thin frame for a resolved one.
emission._thin_floor_why: Identical to config/phase_10d_diag1.json frames.min_intervals_per_frame, and identical to the plotting script's shade_thin() floor. The three must agree or the wash would mark a different set than the one the ladder declined.
emission._tape_why: The tape panel is orientation only; the addendum says downsample freely. 4000 points is more than an HTML axis can resolve and keeps the parquet small. Even stride, first and last print always kept.

plotly_js._why: D14, the environment is offline. `directory` writes one shared plotly.min.js beside the charts. A CDN reference renders a blank page here and is escalation row CH-R2.
